connector.name: Mycase MCP
connector.registryDescription: Connect Claude to MyCase: cases, contacts, documents, tasks, calendar, calls, time, billing, staff.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mycase-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oktopeak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MYCASE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: MyCase OAuth client ID issued by MyCase support for your firm

env.name: MYCASE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: MyCase OAuth client secret issued by MyCase support

env.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: 64-character hex key for encrypting stored OAuth tokens (generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))")

env.name: MYCASE_REDIRECT_PORT
env.description: Local port for the OAuth callback listener (default: 5678). Must match the redirect URI registered with MyCase support.

env.name: MYCASE_EXPERIMENTAL_TOOLS
env.description: Set to '1' to enable experimental tools (log-call) whose API endpoints are unverified.
